item.title: Chan v1.2.9
item.description:
Chan 1.2.9 | Chance
*Note: you may get spammed with Cloudflare popups on first launch of this version, this is normal to refresh how many files are supported for each site*
## New Features
- Cookie editor - Reddit login - Just to bypass 403 error for now, no voting - Setting to disable HTTP/3 - Appears to be blocked in Russia
## General Improvements
- Setting to go back to continuously scrollable tabs
## Tweaks
- Use single file pickers when site only supports one file - Put selected files on the right of file add buttons - New highlight effect for tabs - Restored the /slashes/ to the tab switcher - "Full filename" popup is now selectable - Tried to optimize file converter to avoid multiple passes - Collapse thread loading error when scrolling down - Offer to hide thread loading error when tapped - Rearrange reply posting status when reply form is open
## Bugfixes
- Stuck forever on "Getting captcha" - Extra `}` after board name in saved list - Multiple notification setup errors were not retried - "Limit uploaded file dimensions" setting could cause images to get larger - Sometimes unable to tap on tabs in the first page - Threads did not properly transition to archived - GIF conversion did not respect maximum dimensions - pbs.twimg.com suggested files did not use maximum quality - Avoid causing extra Reddit requests when thumbnails were unavailable - Cloudflare was popping up due to 404 thumbnails in tab list or saved list - HTTP 429 queue could get deadlocked - When request had a redirect - When more than 5 attempts were blocked - Selected tab was buggy when using home board - Migration of sites to support more than 1 file was not done properly - Boards with updated maximum file count were not saved properly - Initial tab switcher position was not restored when launching app via some push notifications - Creating threads gave "Error: thread created" on lynxchan-based sites - Timeout logging in to pass was not handled properly - "Last page" warning appeared on page 1/1 - Clearing cookies did not update pass login status - No way to cancel "Checking url..." popup - Bad handling of HTTP3 headers leading to failed pass login - Bad handling of closing multiple HTTP3 streams at once - Bad handling of HTTP3 error 256 - TLS errors could get confused between different operations - Default user-agent was not fully readable on Android UI - Thread watcher loading bar didn't update immediately - In landscape mode some interface elements were hidden behind system UI - Tab switcher buggy when screen size changed (foldable)
